description: List campaigns. Each item carries `emailPreset`, the linked email's Style > Format (branded or minimal; null for SMS campaigns and standalone raw HTML emails), so chrome can be compared across campaigns without one get_campaign call each. Each item also carries delivery pacing so an account-wide STO audit does not need one get_campaign call each: sendTimeOptimization, sendTimeWindowHours, spreadOverHours, sendInRecipientTimezone, and scheduledTimezone. STO is campaign-only; sequences use sendingWindow. Results are paginated: the default page size is 50 and limit is capped at 100. Always read the returned `pagination` object (`limit`, `offset`, `count`, `total`, `hasMore`) and keep paging with `offset` while `hasMore` is true - a single call does not necessarily return every campaign.

companyId.description: Company ID to list campaigns for. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

label.description: Optional label name filter. Only campaigns assigned this label are returned.

limit.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

status.description: Filter by status (draft, scheduled, sent, sending, cancelled, paused, waiting_approval, or rejected). Rejected campaign results include rejectionComment feedback when provided.

name: list_campaigns

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_campaigns` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

campaigns.description: List of campaign records returned by Sequenzy. hasAudience indicates an explicit audience configuration, not an eligible recipient count. Delivery pacing: sendTimeOptimization is per-campaign Send Time Optimization (not a company or sequence setting). sendTimeWindowHours is that window in hours (default 12, max 24). spreadOverHours is a linear spread that turns STO off. sendInRecipientTimezone is a third mutually exclusive mode. Sequences use sendingWindow, which is an allowed-hours gate, not per-subscriber optimization.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

pagination.description: Campaign page window: `limit`, `offset`, `count` returned in this page, `total` matching the filters, and `hasMore`. Keep calling with an advanced `offset` while `hasMore` is true to enumerate every campaign.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
